title: EvoCast: Reliable Autonomous Research Agents for Iterative Forecasting Architecture Evolution

claim.summary: EvoCast runs a fixed-protocol research loop in which LLM agents propose and implement forecasting-architecture changes while deterministic program authorities validate source boundaries, run canonical evaluation, gate promotion and write outcome-typed evidence.

modules.name: Cognition-authority separated promotion chain
modules.scope_reason: A frozen evaluator, source-boundary checks and a multi-seed promotion gate separate agent proposals from adjudication; as with immutable-evaluator research loops, the chain needs no temporal semantics.

modules.name: Outcome-typed research evidence and failure memory
modules.scope_reason: Accepted, rejected, unstable and failed rounds are written as generic research-state outcomes that do not depend on the forecasting target.
